checks.rationale: Both TASK-001-AC1 and AC2 are supported: immutable qualified identity/revisions, repaired scope conflict values, common evidence/error/result envelopes and complete no-IO lifecycle vocabularies.

Frozen service ownership, specification exclusions and normalized ancestor scope invariant are respected. Project-wide allocation uniqueness remains a later store/validator invariant; this value module performs no IO.

Entire candidate module traced. ScopePath.overlaps at lines 316-321 detects normalized equality/ancestry independently of claim kind; ScopeClaim.conflicts_with applies that to both write/read directions. Independent matrix probes pass.

Invalid IDs, revisions, paths, digests, evidence, scalar collections, non-JSON/cyclic values and contradictory result states fail explicitly. DomainError remains frozen while its ordinary exception wrapper propagates with traceback. No IO resources are acquired.

Both overlap orders, write/write and both write/read directions, exact ancestor files and child directories, case/NFKC aliases, equal locations, siblings and read/read cases pass. Exact-file containment and permissions remain narrow; nested JSON stays detached.

Exact frozen command reran with exit 0 and 15 meaningful tests. Independent evidence also compares 21 schema vocabularies plus two service statuses, nested JSON and identity behavior, and 90 overlap/access/read-only assertions.
The diff adds only one common-value production module, its owned tests and handoff. No service-specific DTO, port, adapter, reducer, shared registry, IO, dependency or contract expansion.

Independent Git name/status reconstruction with rename detection proves exactly the three permitted additions. Base ancestry, clean frozen head, hashes and scope checks pass; no unrelated, prohibited, renamed or deleted paths.

Typed explicit flat-module exports, frozen values and detached JSON, focused normalization helpers and separate throwable error wrapper provide maintainable public interfaces without central export changes.

Portable path validation rejects traversal/absolute/drive/UNC, Windows device/ADS and unsafe Unicode forms. Conservative normalized ancestor conflicts close the prior scope gap. Scope remains lexical with no external effects; runtime filesystem checks belong to later owners.

Task-owned handoff accurately records interfaces, acceptance, immutable values, no IO, repaired conflict-versus-permission behavior and previous failure lineage. Frozen candidate and independent evidence provide exact final identity and current validation.
